environment.tool: manual audit of the tag source + live compiled binary; openssl s_client for SNI, strict upstream peer

findings.description: The SNI callback sets only the certificate and never the route, so the two authorities are independent on this build too.
findings.title: Host and SNI are independent authorities and are never reconciled

findings.description: SNI beta.test plus Host alpha.test yields beta's certificate, a passing hostname verify, and execution on alpha's proxied route in a single request.
findings.title: Host and SNI are independent authorities and are never reconciled

findings.description: The upstream Host is the constant 127.0.0.1:<port>; client Host is routing-only.
findings.title: Host and SNI are independent authorities and are never reconciled

findings.description: validate_nodes() contains the server_name checks but load() never calls it, so every name check in the function is dead code on this build.
findings.title: Host and SNI are independent authorities and are never reconciled

findings.description: The validhost() call inside validate_nodes never executes at load time, which is why malformed names are accepted and then unreachable.
findings.title: Host and SNI are independent authorities and are never reconciled

findings.description: The Host validator itself is strict (rejects trailing dot, underscore, wildcard), which is why the names accepted by the dead validator cannot be routed to.
findings.title: Host and SNI are independent authorities and are never reconciled
